cards.title: Bandipur Bazaar
cards.blurb: A Newar trading town frozen in time on a saddle above the highway, with car-free streets and a view of the whole Himalayan range.

cards.title: Gorkha Durbar
cards.blurb: The hilltop palace of King Prithvi Narayan Shah, from where the unification of Nepal began in the 18th century.

cards.title: Tansen and Rani Mahal
cards.blurb: Hill town of Palpa, and the riverside 'Taj Mahal of Nepal' built by a general for his late wife on the Kali Gandaki.

cards.title: Rara Lake
cards.blurb: Nepal's largest lake, deep blue at 2,990 m in the remote north-west, ringed by pine and juniper.

cards.title: Palpali Dhaka Topi
cards.blurb: The patterned cap woven on handlooms in Palpa — part of Nepal's national dress.

cards.title: Palpali Karuwa
cards.blurb: A bronze water jug cast by Palpa's metalworkers, given at weddings and festivals.

cards.title: Siddha Cave
cards.blurb: One of the largest caves in Nepal, below Bandipur. Take a guide and torch, or feel your way. Roll for how deep you go.

cards.title: Ridge Walk Race
cards.blurb: Race one traveller along the ridge to Thani Mai temple for the sunrise. Highest roll gets there first.
